## Clinical Delivery — Clinical Operations

### Sites and coverage

HealthCore will serve Meridian Manufacturing from its Austin, Texas facility. We propose using clinic us-tx-001 as the base for on-site services. This clinic is located in Austin and can support the 3-day/week schedule. We will deploy a dedicated team to the client site. Coverage includes injury triage, wellness screenings, and chronic condition management. We do not assume capacity at us-tx-001 without confirmation.

### Staffing and capacity

The RFP requires a clinical capacity and staffing plan. We propose the following roles for the 3-day/week clinic:
- One Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) for injury triage and treatment.
- One Registered Nurse (RN) for wellness screenings and chronic condition support.
- One Health Coach for diabetes and hypertension management.

Total hours: 24 hours per week (8 hours per day, 3 days). We can adjust roles based on client needs. We have no published staff capacity per clinic. We must confirm availability of these roles at us-tx-001. Peak screening periods may require additional temporary staff. We will confirm this with our staffing team.

### Clinical services

We will deliver:
- Injury and illness triage and treatment for workplace incidents.
- Annual wellness screenings for all 800 employees.
- Chronic condition management for diabetes and hypertension.

We will use HealthCore protocols for triage and chronic care. Screenings may occur on clinic days or separate events. We will coordinate scheduling with Meridian. We will provide references from two similar manufacturing clients.

### Open questions

- What specific clinical roles are required for the 3-day/week clinic (e.g., physician, NP, RN, MA)?
- Are wellness screenings to be conducted on-site during the 3 clinic days or on separate days?
- What is the expected volume of injury/illness visits per week or month?
- Are there any specific hours of operation for the clinic (e.g., 8am-5pm)?
- Does the client require 24/7 on-call coverage for injury triage outside clinic hours?
- What is the available staff capacity at clinic us-tx-001 for this contract?

## Commercial Terms — Revenue Cycle

### Pricing and currency
All prices are quoted in USD. HealthCore proposes a per-employee, per-month pricing model for the occupational health clinic, wellness screenings, and chronic disease management. The pricing component carries a 25% weight in the evaluation. Because the client has not provided a budget or volume detail, the base fee is [amount to be confirmed by Revenue Cycle]. Any volume discounts or fixed-fee alternatives will be discussed after budget confirmation.

### Payment structure
HealthCore recommends monthly invoicing for predictability. The exact payment schedule and method (e.g., electronic transfer) are [payment terms to be confirmed by Revenue Cycle]. No early-payment discounts or late-payment penalties are included unless agreed in the final contract.

### Contract term
The initial term is 12 months, beginning on the service start date agreed with Meridian Manufacturing. The contract includes an option to renew for additional periods. Renewal pricing, notice periods, and any price adjustment mechanisms are not yet defined and remain open for negotiation. The proposal must be submitted by August 23, 2026, to meet the deadline.

A Business Associate Agreement (BAA) compliant with HIPAA will be executed as part of the contract. All terms are subject to HealthCore compliance approval before closing.

### Open questions
- What is Meridian Manufacturing's budget range for this contract?
- Does the client prefer a per-employee fee, a fixed monthly fee, or a combination?
- What renewal terms are expected (e.g., price indexation, notice period)?
- What payment frequency does the client prefer (monthly, quarterly, or annual)?

## Data Protection and Compliance — Compliance and Data Governance

### Regulatory framework

This proposal is for a US client, Meridian Manufacturing, Inc. We will comply with HIPAA. HealthCore acts as a Business Associate. We handle protected health information (PHI) only for treatment, payment, and health care operations. We limit PHI use to the minimum necessary. We will notify you of any breach within 60 days of discovery. You will receive only aggregate, de-identified program reports. We never share individual health records with the client.

### Business Associate Agreement (BAA)

We will execute a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) compliant with HIPAA before the contract starts. This is mandatory for US clients. We will provide our standard BAA template for your review and negotiation. The BAA covers all required HIPAA safeguards.

### Data Security Practices Assessment

We assess our data security measures to meet your expectations and regulatory standards. Our practices include encryption, access controls, and breach notification procedures. We will prepare a summary of these practices for your evaluation. We can also discuss certifications like SOC 2 or ISO 27001 if required.

### Compliance approval

Compliance approval is mandatory before signing. Claire Whitfield, Chief Compliance Officer, must approve the final contract. This step is not optional. We will coordinate with your team to ensure all requirements are met.

### Open questions

- What specific data security practices or certifications (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001) does the client require?
- What is the significance of the '25%' mentioned in [P28]?
- Are there any additional state-level privacy regulations (e.g., CCPA) that apply to this engagement?
